# Three-tier EC P-256 chain for intermediate-completion tests: root_cert (self-signed, serial 1) ->
# issuer_cert (CA:TRUE, serial 2) -> leaf_cert (serial 3, CN/SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth+clientAuth).
# Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, all ecdsa-with-SHA256. Leaf-only presentation cannot reach root without issuer_cert.
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (root, iss, leaf)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Intermediate Test Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash" -out root.pem
#   openssl req -new -key iss.key -subj "/CN=TlsLib Intermediate Test Issuer" -out iss.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in iss.csr -CA root.pem -CAkey root.key -set_serial 2 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile iss.ext -out iss.pem
#     iss.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA iss.pem -CAkey iss.key -set_serial 3 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted iss.pem leaf.pem   (OK);  openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
issuer_
leaf_
